reasons: Initial pilot requires at least 8 independent teachers

raw_ledger_duplication.limitation: raw.json retains both completed attempt and accepted record copies; cumulative ledger rewrites and independent pair.json copies also charged; larger cohorts not measured by fake ledgers

scope: one complete engineering resource teacher; no scientificpilot/freeze/T

diagnostics.bootstrap_unit: whole teacher; all inner repetitions remain together
diagnostics.coverage_limit: Empirical bootstrap and t sensitivity do not establish nominal coverage
diagnostics.engineering_limitations: Bounded machinery exercise, not final policies or genuine pilot evidence
diagnostics.future_namespaces: confirmatory teacher/data/observation namespaces reserved; pilot never reuses them

intrinsic_variance.assumptions: Conditional on teacher/development data: iid optimizer draws, iid E rows independent of optimizers, finite second moments; independent teachers
intrinsic_variance.bound: max(0, observed teacher-mean variance 2.5% lower - mean nuisance allowance 97.5% upper)
intrinsic_variance.decomposition: D = teacher mean + optimizer main effect + E-row main effect + centered optimizer-by-E interaction
intrinsic_variance.interaction_policy: conservative double counting; no residual subtraction
intrinsic_variance.limitation: Conservative decomposition in expectation; empirical whole-teacher bootstrap bounds are conditional approximations, not finite-sample coverage guarantees
intrinsic_variance.nuisance_allowance: rep-mean sample variance/R + row-mean sample variance/N; expectation A/R + B/N + 2*C/(R*N)
intrinsic_variance.tail_policy: Two 2.5% one-sided bootstrap tails; union bound needs no independence between endpoints

diagnostics.row_variance: variance across E rows after per-row repetition averaging; shared E correlations retained

tagged_clock_rule: exclusive_ns are disjoint within instrumented call tree; inclusive_ns are nested and must not be added; unhooked stage IO stays inside stage residual
